questions.stem: When Westbrook Auto Parts, a fast-growing firm launched its Fairhaven product, a small group of venturesome customers bought it almost immediately, eager to try something new despite the risk. Which adopter category are these customers?
questions.explanation: Innovators are the first to adopt an innovation, driven by curiosity and willingness to take risks. They are followed by early adopters, then the early majority, late majority and finally laggards. A venturesome group buying almost immediately fits innovators, who help a new product gain its initial foothold.
questions.hint: The very first, risk-taking buyers are innovators.

options.misconception: confuses eager first buyers with sceptical late adopters
mistakes the very first buyers with the last to adopt
assumes a cautious, deliberate adoption timing
